units: <cite ref="Shabbat 33a:13">Sabb. 33ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 49b:8">Kidd. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>סימן לגסות</he> (<he>הרוח</he>) <he>ע׳</he> poverty is a symptom of haughtiness (haughtiness will be followed by poverty).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 49b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מאי ע׳ ע׳ דתורה</he> the poverty (of the Babylonians) means poverty of the Law (ignorance).

<cite ref="Shabbat 102b:3">Sabb. 102ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 106b:14">Keth. 106ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין ע׳ במקום עשירות</he> there must be no stint where there is wealth, i.e. you must not be small in large affairs.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:14">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> <he>אלו נתקבצו … והע׳ לצד אחר הע׳ וכ׳</he> if all suffering were gathered on one side, and poverty on the other, poverty would outweigh all.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:14">Ib.</cite> <he>אמר הקב״ה … עֲנִיּוּתוֹ וכ׳</he> the Lord says (to the usurer), is not this man’s poverty enough, that thou &c.?; a. fr.—Esth. R. introd. (play on <he>באניות</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 28:68">Deut. XXVIII, 68</cite>) <he>בע׳ ממעשים טובים</he> in thy want of good deeds.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:5:7">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵇ</cite> top <he>בעֲנִיּוּתֵינוּ צריכה וכ׳</he> according to our poverty (of mind), she requires a letter of divorce from him.
